verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB explicitly claims CHKit offers typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code, which 'an agent can drive, in CI'. Its native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface let any client or driver run queries non-interactively, and the MCP server exposes tools to run SQL and read monitoring. Missing for 10: in-depth CHKit/CI documentation or examples, documented programmatic API/CLI for cluster provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.
